speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when did the bleeding and abdominal pain start?

speaker: Patient
text: I am at 38 weeks gestation, and the vaginal bleeding and severe abdominal pain started about an hour ago. speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of third-trimester vaginal bleeding, severe abdominal pain, and the confirmed imaging findings is diagnostic. DIAGNOSIS READY: Placental Abruption
